name: overall_ranking
caption: Development R² per configuration, averaged over the development datasets and training seeds, as horizontal bars coloured by model kind with whiskers for the training-seed standard deviation.

name: credit_vs_control
caption: Per-model mean R² on the holdout datasets for credit-prior arms, control arms and external baselines, one point per model with a bar at each group mean.

name: beats_reference
caption: Each trained arm's mean R² on the holdout datasets minus the released TabICLv2's, one horizontal bar per arm coloured by kind, with a reference line at zero.

name: metric_grid

name: lever_effect
caption: Mean R² by the value of each fine-tuning lever, one panel per lever: credit fraction, freeze strategy, L2-SP and learning rate.

name: per_dataset
caption: Best R² of each model kind per real dataset as grouped bars, development datasets first and then holdout, each labelled with its side of the split.

name: per_dataset_heatmap
